label: Home
blurb: A primary home: the full monthly cost, cash to close and how much income a lender expects.

label: Home with a rental
blurb: Live in the home and rent a unit, ADU or basement. Shows what you still pay after rent, and a bad year.

label: Condo
blurb: Condo costs hinge on dues and assessments. Shows the all-in monthly figure and what share is dues.

label: Co-op
blurb: A co-op is shares in a building. Monthly maintenance covers the building's taxes and often its mortgage; selling may trigger a flip tax.

label: House hacker
blurb: Buy a 2 to 4 unit property, live in one unit and rent the rest. Shows your housing cost now and the numbers if you later move out.

label: Vacation home
blurb: A second home you use part of the year and may rent. Includes the IRS 14-day test and cost per personal day.

label: Land and build
blurb: Buy a lot and build. Counts the months with no rent and the cost of delays.

label: Investment property
blurb: Buy and hold a rental. Cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, break-even occupancy and a multi-year gain.

label: Pure rental income
blurb: Rentals as retirement income. How many units reach your monthly target, and how fragile it is.

label: House flipper
blurb: Buy, renovate and sell. Profit, return on cash, the 70% rule and what a lower sale price does.

label: Renter + business + investments
blurb: You rent and invest. Compares your net worth with buying a home and investing the rest, over time.

label: Influencer house (commercial mansion)
blurb: A large home that earns from creator rooms, content-studio rentals and brand events.

label: Hacker house (tech house, GitHub edition)
blurb: A shared house for builders: bedrooms, coworking passes and hackathons, with fast internet and shared costs.

label: Music producer mansion with rentals
blurb: A mansion with recording rooms rented by the hour, residency bedrooms and shoot or event bookings.
